# Issue #2159 complete unknown-type inventory

This inventory records every in-scope AST row at commit `2fadb59ac222308eee31e367a1c5b736f9ee7871`. The audit covers tracked `packages/**/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}` files, including tests, helpers, fixtures, and files directly below a package `src` directory. It excludes declaration files. No genuinely generated tracked TypeScript source was found at this revision.

The 4,359 rows comprise 4,340 casts and 19 accepted retained production state annotations. `N/D` means no likely lint rule is determinable from the current syntax and data flow. The binary verdict addresses issue #2159 lint abuse only. Test-support assertions are legitimate when they construct mocks, malformed inputs, or partial runtime values without retaining a production lint-invalid check.
